description: This Java class 'TestSearchUpdaterStream' provides utility methods for testing parts of the updater stream logic in the 'thingsearch' persistence module. It enables writing and deleting 'Thing' objects to and from the updater stream, mainly used in unit tests.

classes.name: TestSearchUpdaterStream
classes.description: Utility class for testing the updater stream, providing methods to write and delete 'Thing' objects within tests.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the test stream with given MongoDatabase.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a 'Thing' object into the updater stream with the specified enforcer and policy revision.

methods.name: writeThingWithAcl
methods.description: Writes a 'Thing' with an ACL into the updater stream.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a 'Thing' identified by its ID and revision from the updater stream, with optional policy ID and revision.
